title: Njord: A Probabilistic Graph Neural Network for Ensemble Ocean Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2605.15470v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ocean dynamics are inherently chaotic, yet existing machine learning ocean models produce only deterministic forecasts. We introduce Njord, a probabilistic data-driven model for ocean forecasting, applicable to both global and regional domains. Njord combines a deep latent variable framework with a graph neural network architecture, enabling sampling each forecast step in a single forward pass. We apply Njord globally at 0.25{\deg} resolution and regionally to the Baltic Sea at 2 km resolution. To scale to these large ocean grids we introduce K-means cluster meshes that adapt to irregular sea surface geometry. Experiments demonstrate strong performance on both domains compared to deterministic machine learning baselines, while also providing uncertainty estimates from the sampled ensemble forecasts. On the global OceanBench benchmark, Njord achieves the lowest errors on average across upper-ocean variables when evaluated against real

translated_title: Njord：用于海洋集合预报的概率图神经网络
translated_abstract: 海洋动力学本质上具有混沌特性，然而现有的机器学习海洋模型只能产生确定性预报。我们提出了Njord，一个用于海洋预报的概率性数据驱动模型，适用于全球和区域两个尺度。Njord将深度潜变量框架与图神经网络架构相结合，能够在单次前向传播中对每个预报步骤进行采样。我们将Njord应用于全球0.25°分辨率以及波罗的海2公里分辨率的区域预报。为了扩展到这些大型海洋网格，我们引入了能够适应不规则海面几何形状的K-means聚类网格。实验表明，与确定性机器学习基线相比，该模型在两个尺度上均表现出强劲性能，同时还能从采样的集合预报中提供不确定性估计。在全球OceanBench基准测试中，Njord在与真实观测对比评估时，在上层海洋变量上取得了平均最低误差。
tldr: Njord是一个将深度潜变量框架与图神经网络相结合的概率性海洋预报模型，通过自适应不规则海面几何的K-means聚类网格实现全球0.25°和波罗的海2公里分辨率的预报，在单次前向传播中即可采样集合预报，性能超越确定性机器学习基线并提供不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: Njord is a probabilistic ocean forecasting model combining deep latent variables with graph neural networks, leveraging K-means cluster meshes to adapt to irregular sea surface geometry, enabling ensemble sampling in a single forward pass at both global 0.25° and Baltic Sea 2 km resolutions, outperforming deterministic ML baselines while providing uncertainty estimates.
